text: キラキラと　あかく　ひかる　きれいな　ほうせきの　かけら。

structure.jp: キラキラと　あかく　ひかる
きれいな　ほうせきの

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: キラキラと　あかく　ひかる　きれいな　ほうせき
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a noun describes that noun. あかく　ひかる　きれいな　ほうせき = 'a pretty gem that shines red'.

patterns.name: 〜と (how)
patterns.explanation: と after a sound-picture word shows the way something happens. キラキラと = 'with a sparkle'.

patterns.name: 〜く
patterns.explanation: Changing い to く lets a describing word tell how an action is done. あかく　ひかる = 'shines red'.
